description: List trending pre-cleared Commercial Music Library tracks for a connected TikTok account. Returns up to 100 trending sounds with musicSoundId, name, artist, duration, and preview/thumbnail URLs. Pass a musicSoundId to create_posts as tiktokMusicSoundId to attach that sound to a TikTok photo, carousel or video post. genre takes raw TikTok values like 'POP', 'HIP_HOP/RAP', 'R&B/SOUL', 'K-POP' (invalid values return the full valid list in the error). The list rotates daily — fetch fresh rather than reusing old ids for display. An unknown countryCode returns an empty list. If the API returns tiktokMusic.requiresBusinessApi, the TikTok account needs a one-time reconnect.

countryCode.description: 2-letter uppercase country code (default US). Unknown codes return an empty list.

genre.description: Raw TikTok genre value, e.g. 'POP', 'HIP_HOP/RAP', 'R&B/SOUL', 'K-POP'. Omit for all genres; an invalid value returns the full valid list in the error.

name: list_tiktok_sounds
title: List TikTok Sounds
